newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan banks to chase private sector bad debts.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan banks to chase private sector bad debts.

text.p: The Pakistani government on Tuesday asked banks to start a campaign on a "war footing" to recover bad debts from the private sector, Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz said.

"Our top priority is the recovery of stuck up loans... which constitute 15 to 20 percent of total portfolio of the banks," he told reporters after Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif chaired a bankers' meeting at the central bank in Karachi.
"All banks will start a campaign for loan recovery on war footing soon," he said. "They will have full government support," he added.
Aziz said Sharif had had given three months for ailing industrial concerns to revive so that unpaid loans could be recovered.
"Those industrial units which can't be revived will go into liquidation," he said.
Sharif told reporters there were 3,700 ailing industrial units in Pakistan.
